status: experimental coordination architecture; no adjudicative or legal-authority claim
purpose: Provide reusable dispute, mediation, cure, negotiated remediation, settlement-candidate, and escalation semantics without turning a mediator, reviewer, or dispute engine into an authority root.
core_invariants: dispute state never creates punishment or remedy authority
a mediator proposal is advisory unless a separate valid process explicitly grants a bounded adjudicative role
competing evidence is preserved rather than collapsed into a single narrative without basis
settlement candidates require explicit acceptance by affected parties
material settlement terms require the same renewed acceptance protections as material contract amendments
remedies that create consequential effects re-enter the ordinary local authority path
withdrawal from mediation does not erase evidence or extinguish external rights/remedies
urgent risk containment may proceed only through separately preauthorized safety mechanisms
evidence_model: proposed remedies and their side effects
negotiated_remediation_principles: prefer reversible remedies where outcomes are uncertain
prefer the narrowest intervention that addresses the substantiated harm
separate acknowledgement/apology/correction from coercive remedy authority
preserve appeal or escalation where appropriate
do not infer bad faith solely from refusal to settle
nonclaims: This profile does not create a court, arbitrator, regulator, or legal judgment.
This profile does not determine truth merely because a majority of agents agree.
This profile does not authorize asset seizure, penalties, suspension, or coercive enforcement.
This profile does not replace emergency safety controls.
